At back right a plain brown wooden drying/storage cabinet with shelves and simple doors; one door slightly ajar, cabinet interior dim and dry, not lit by direct sun. A few unobtrusive practical hand tools at the far edge of the bench, no clutter, no identifiable logos. No person and NO lacquer board on the mat yet; the empty pad provides the consistent place for a 30 by 20 cm board in subsequent assets. Camera near operator height, slightly above the bench, three-quarter wide view; bench foreground and left window spatial relation clearly visible, natural straight perspective. Neutral blacks, soft gray, dark brown; quiet contemporary documentary realism, believable wood grain and subtle working wear.
